description: The no-status-filter case, and the lowest-numbered case in this folder whose row is written inline rather than taken from the fixture: a card whose CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS is 'N' is displayed exactly as an active one is, because CBACT02C never looks at the field. THE CLAIM AND ITS EVIDENCE: a grep for ACTIVE-STATUS over app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl returns nothing - the string does not occur anywhere in the program. Its complete decision surface is three IF CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' gates (:121 open, :94 read, :139 close), the nested IF CARDFILE-STATUS = '10' at :98, the two IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' guards at :75 and :77, the two 88-level condition names APPL-AOK and APPL-EOF declared at :62-63 and tested at :104, :126, :144 and :107, and the two-branch IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC OR IO-STAT1 = '9' at :162-163 inside 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS. Every one of those tests reads a file status or a loop flag; not one reads a record field. The program reads a record and displays its bytes, and that is all it does - so an inactive card must produce the same three lines an active one produces, and a translation that filtered it, skipped it, warned about it or annotated it would be inventing a business rule (practice B5). WHY THE ROW IS SYNTHESIZED: all fifty rows of app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt carry CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS = 'Y' - verified mechanically over byte 91 of every row - so the fixture cannot express an inactive card and no fromRow/rowCount range over it can reach this input. THE DERIVATION, exactly: synthesized from app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt row 1 by replacing one-based offset 91 (CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS) with 'N'; all other 149 bytes unchanged; all 50 fixture rows carry 'Y', so the fixture cannot express this input. The Hamming distance from that row is therefore exactly one, at position 91 alone: characters 1-90 are byte-identical to the fixture's first row - CARD-NUM 0500024453765740, CARD-ACCT-ID 00000000050, CARD-CVV-CD 747, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 'Aniya Von' followed by 41 spaces, and CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 2023-03-09 carrying the copybook's own misspelling, never corrected - and characters 92-150 are FILLER's 59 spaces. 'Y' and 'N' are the two values this field takes across the estate, which COCRDLIC, COCRDSLC and COCRDUPC display and edit, so 'N' is a realistic value rather than an arbitrary byte. THE MUTATION LIVES ONLY IN THIS FILE (practice B3): app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt and the classpath copy at src/test/resources/fixtures/carddata.txt are read-only parity oracle and are NOT edited to add an 'N' row; the inline rows member exists for exactly this need, and the row is seeded verbatim. WHAT THIS CASE PINS ABOUT THE UNIT: it is account.AccountBalanceReaderJob - an Account-named class in the account package - yet CBACT02C reads the CARD file and never touches the account file. :29-33 is SELECT CARDFILE-FILE ASSIGN TO CARDFILE, ORGANIZATION INDEXED, ACCESS MODE SEQUENTIAL, RECORD KEY FD-CARD-NUM, over an FD of FD-CARD-NUM X(16) plus FD-CARD-DATA X(134) = 150, and :45 is COPY CVACT02Y. AAP rule R1 governs - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and the divergence is catalogued in the register at AAP 0.8.4. THE RUN is :70-87 exactly once. :71 displays the start banner. :72 performs 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN, whose OPEN INPUT at :120 reports '00', so :121 takes its first arm and :126-127 CONTINUE. The first READ at :93 lands on the CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' arm at :94 and :78 displays CARD-RECORD - the 01 group item, so the whole 150-byte area including FILLER, and the 'N' with it. The second READ reports '10', :99 moves 16 into APPL-RESULT, :107 finds the 88-level APPL-EOF true and :108 moves 'Y' into END-OF-FILE, so the loop ends without a second display. 9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE reports '00' at :139, :140 SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT leaves zero, the end banner follows at :85, and GOBACK at :87 leaves RETURN-CODE 0. In repository terms the sequence is startBrowse '00', then readNext '00' delivering the record, then readNext '10' at end of file, then endBrowse '00' (gate G47). The job is driven at tasklet/step level, with no JobLauncher and no HTTP in the path (gate G51). MESSAGE ARITHMETIC: 1 start banner + 1 record image + 1 end banner = 3 ordered DISPLAY_LINE entries, of 38, 150 and 36 characters. Exactly one image per record, because the DISPLAY inside the read paragraph at :96 is a COMMENT and no display paragraph exists, so :78 is the only live display. RECORD GEOMETRY, taken mechanically from app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy (RECLN 150) rather than counted off a fixture line by eye (practice B11), one-based and cumulative so a reviewer can check this file against the copybook without running anything: CARD-NUM X(16) at 1-16 and also the RECORD KEY, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) at 17-27, CARD-CVV-CD 9(03) at 28-30, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50) at 31-80, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10) at 81-90, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01) at 91 - which is where 16+11+3+50+10 = 90 puts it - and FILLER X(59) at 92-150. 16+11+3+50+10+1+59 = 150 (gate G19), and those trailing 59 spaces are significant and must not be trimmed (gate G21). The copybook declares no COMP-3, no PACKED-DECIMAL and no S9, so every numeric span is unsigned zoned DISPLAY and there is no sign overpunch to model on this path. WIRING: app/jcl/READCARD.jcl:22 is a bare //STEP05 EXEC PGM=CBACT02C and the job declares no PARM anywhere, so jobParameters is empty; its single //CARDFILE DD at :25-26 is the only dataset seeded, addressed by the CARDFILE binding key that application.yml resolves at record length 150 and never by a dataset name, so no DSNAME literal appears in this file (gate G46). ENCODING is US-ASCII, named explicitly rather than left to a platform default. NOTHING IS WRITTEN: expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty because :120 opens INPUT and the program contains no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE - SYSOUT at READCARD.jcl:27 is its only output - and no normalisation is declared, because this row is already the full 150 bytes CVACT02Y declares. PROVENANCE: every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl, cross-checked against app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy for each offset and width, app/jcl/READCARD.jcl for the step and DD contract, and the real app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt for the ninety bytes this row inherits verbatim. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: AAP 0.7.6 proves that impossible in this environment with eight independently verified blockers - no z/OS runtime, the available compiler's indexed file handler disabled, subprogram linkage that cannot be made executable, a copybook that will not parse, no Language Environment CEE services, no CICS emulator plus three absent IBM copybooks, EBCDIC fixtures needing binary handling, and no alternative compiler installable - and the substitution is recorded as risk R-A. One inactive card in, three lines out, RETURN-CODE 0 - the same shape an active card produces, which is the whole point.
